metadata.description: Official Appstrate plugins for Claude Code

plugins.name: appstrate
plugins.description: Your Appstrate organization's skills, synced every session. Installs on a fresh machine; run `appstrate login` once (the plugin's setup skill says how)

source.command: if command -v appstrate >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec appstrate code sync --target claude-plugin --target codex --print-path; else exec npx -y appstrate@latest code sync --target claude-plugin --target codex --print-path; fi
